pages.text: The sun climbed high. A big tree stood on the bank.
Dingding looked into paddy water. Grass hid the tree's base, but the whole shadow showed in the water. "This morning, it lay over there."
"I want lunch somewhere cool." Mom came with the meal basket.
She spread a bamboo mat left of the tree, taking out bowls. "Cool here yesterday."
But sunshine blazed on the left. The mat was hot.
Mom fanned, sweat dripping. "Not like this yesterday."
Sunlight sparkled in the bowls. Mom squinted.
Dingding looked in the water again. The long shadow lay right of the tree.
Mom dragged the mat over too. "Yesterday's sun must have been lazy."
